name: capture_screen
summary: Capture the screen to an image file and return its path, dimensions, and size. Saves to ~/Pictures/Screenshots by default; pass output_path to save elsewhere. Open the returned path to view the image. Requires the Screen Recording permission (System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen Recording); a denied permission is reported with a grant hint. Captures the whole desktop, never a specific window or region (those are not yet supported).

params.name: output_path
params.description: Where to save the screenshot. If it is an existing directory (e.g. ~/Desktop), the file is created inside it with a generated name. Otherwise it is the full file path (e.g. ~/Desktop/login.png), and its parent folder is created if needed. A recognized image extension here sets the format. Supports a leading ~. Refuses to overwrite an existing file. Omit to save to ~/Pictures/Screenshots.

params.name: display
params.description: 1-based index of the display to capture (1 is the main display). Omit to capture the main display.
